title: Coherent contravariant diagram of sites
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A coherent contravariant diagram of small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] over a small category $I$ consists of a pseudofunctor $F:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Cat}$ with its specified unit and composition isomorphisms satisfying the coherence laws, a covering precoverage on each small category $\mathcal C_i=F(i)$ satisfying the site axioms, and continuous transition functors $u_a:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$ for $a:i\to j$, preserving the pullbacks used for covering families.
